description: E1: a lead only (milestone E builds what lies behind it). After the Moot is settled the clan - or Harrok - tells what the herders bring from the east: a road burned black toward the kingdom, a glow on the hills at night, and something walking at its head. The lead is heard and noted in the journal (lead.cinder.heard); nothing of the Cinder Titan is built.

stages.objective: Heard: a road burned black toward the kingdom, east of the Stonehold
stages.waiting_text: The herders' tale is all there is yet: smoke on the eastern hills and a black road behind it.
